data.name: Nuzayh
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Nuzah was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who was given the title ‘Nuzah’ because he followed the Prophet closely. The name is derived from the Arabic word ‘nazaha’, which means ‘to follow’ or ‘to succeed’. Nuzayh is a name with deep historical and spiritual significance in Islam, symbolizing loyalty, dedication, and commitment to the Prophet’s teachings.
